abo_vm_test_case_manual.tc_name: Verify Initial Alert Handling and Weather Update (Positive Flow)
abo_vm_test_case_manual.tc_description:
Test Case Title: Verify Initial Alert Handling and Weather Update (Positive Flow)
Module: Weather Update & Alert Handling
Priority: High

Preconditions:
- - User has launched the weather application.
- - Device has stable internet connectivity.
- - No prior dialogs or alerts are blocking the UI.

Test Steps:
1. Wait for the visibility of the “OK” button on the alert dialog.
2. Tap on the “OK” button.
3. Wait for the visibility of the “Wind” text on the main dashboard.
4. Swipe down on the weather dashboard.
5. Tap on the “Update” text view.

Expected Result:
- - The “OK” button is displayed and enabled when the alert appears.
- - The alert dialog is dismissed after tapping “OK”.
- - The dashboard displays the “Wind” text, indicating weather information is visible.
- - Pull-to-refresh animation appears after swiping down.
- - Weather data updates after tapping “Update”, reflecting the latest values on the UI.

abo_vm_test_case_manual_steps.step_action: Wait for the visibility of the “OK” button on the alert dialog.
Wait for the visibility of the “Wind” text on the main dashboard.
Swipe down on the weather dashboard.

abo_vm_test_case_manual.tc_name: Search for an Invalid Location and Validate Error Handling (Negative Flow)
abo_vm_test_case_manual.tc_description:
Test Case Title: Search for an Invalid Location and Validate Error Handling (Negative Flow)
Module: Location Search Functionality
Priority: Medium

Preconditions:
- - User is on the main screen of the weather application.
- - Device has stable internet connectivity.

Test Steps:
1. Tap on the “Search” button.
2. Wait for the visibility of the “Search location” edit text field.
3. Type “XYZInvalidLocation” in the search location edit field.
4. Wait for the search results to load or indicate absence.

Expected Result:
- - The search field accepts the input without crashes.
- - No valid location options (such as “IN”) are displayed in the result.
- - An error message or “No results found” indication is shown to the user.
- - The user remains within the search modal without navigation to a location detail or crash.

Type “XYZInvalidLocation” in the search location edit field.
Wait for the search results to load or indicate absence.

abo_vm_test_case_manual.tc_name: Toggle Notification Setting at Boundary State (Edge Case)
abo_vm_test_case_manual.tc_description:
Test Case Title: Toggle Notification Setting at Boundary State (Edge Case)
Module: Settings Configuration
Priority: Low

Preconditions:
- - User is on the main screen of the weather application.
- - User has not previously enabled notifications.

Test Steps:
1. Tap on the Navigation Drawer to open the side menu.
2. Wait for the visibility of “Settings”.
3. Tap on “Settings”.
4. Wait for the visibility of “General settings”.
5. Tap on “General settings”.
6. Wait for the visibility of “Enable notifications” toggle.
7. Rapidly toggle the “Enable notifications” switch ON and OFF 5 times.

Expected Result:
- - The toggle responds to rapid user input without lag, freezing, or crashing.
- - The final setting reflects the last toggle state (either ON or OFF).
- - The application's preference persists and matches the toggle state after rapid actions.
- - No duplicate notifications or system errors occur due to rapid changes.

abo_vm_test_case_manual_steps.step_action: Tap on the Navigation Drawer to open the side menu.
Wait for the visibility of “General settings”.
Wait for the visibility of “Enable notifications” toggle.
Rapidly toggle the “Enable notifications” switch ON and OFF 5 times.
